_comment: Default answers for the Frido Consumer Survey form.
_instructions: Keys are question indices (0-based, matching the order questions appear in the form).
QUESTION INDEX MAP:
0  — Are you aware of the brand 'Frido'?            [radio: Yes | No | Don't Know]
1  — Do you know about Ergonomic Lifestyle Products? [radio: Yes | No | Don't Know]
2  — Where did you first hear about Frido?           [radio: 15 options]
3  — Which Frido product categories are you aware of?[checkbox: 6 options]
4  — Aware of specific health benefits?              [radio: Yes | No | Don't Know]
5  — Which product category prefer purchasing?       [radio: 5 options]
6  — What primary purpose drives your interest?      [radio: 5 options]
7  — Preferred budget per ergonomic product?         [radio: 4 budget ranges]
8  — Rank product attributes (Q9 in form)            [ranking grid 5x5 — set as dict of row_index → rank 1-5]
9  — Rank product offerings  (Q10 in form)           [ranking grid 5x5 — set as dict of row_index → rank 1-5]
10  — Perception Likert scale (30 statements)         [likert grid — set answer to SD/D/N/A/SA for all rows]
11  — Age                                             [radio: 4 age ranges]
12  — Gender                                          [radio: Male | Female | Prefer not to say | Other]
13  — Annual income bracket                           [radio: 4 income ranges]
14  — Highest education level                         [radio: 4 levels]
Set 'randomize': true to force randomization for that question even if 'answer' is provided.
Remove a question entry entirely to have it fully randomized.
CHECKBOX (Q3): provide 'answer' as a list of option strings.
LIKERT (Q10):  provide 'answer' as SD / D / N / A / SA to apply to ALL rows.
RANKING GRID (Q8/Q9): provide 'answer' as an object: { 'row_index': 'rank_1_to_5' }.

0._note: First question — always Yes as required
